title: Transport Admission Announcement – Fall 2026
text:
Transport Section

Abdul Wali Khan University, Mardan

Ph: 0937-920875 • Email: transport@awkum.edu.pk

No.
AWKUM/Transport/2026/

Dated:
25/8/2026

Notification

This is to notify all concerned that the
Fall Semester 2026
will commence on
1st September 2026
. Students wishing to avail the AWKUM Transport Facility are required to log in to their MIS Account and complete fresh registration for the relevant route buses. Registration will remain open from
25th August 2026 to 25th September 2026
. Students who were previously registered during the Spring Semester 2026 are also required to complete this new registration at the Transport Section in order to continue availing the facility.

Note:
The following routes are subject to appropriate student registration — Sawaldher/Gaddar, Bakhshali, Gujrat, Kohi Burmol, Yar Hussain, Dobyan, Lundkhwar, Gul Maira, Hathyan.
